snapshot.title: Orchard Standpipe: Site Verification Protocol Initiated

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
fields.to: Security & Emergency Manager (SEC), Director of Water Operations (IC), Distribution Operations
fields.cc: Water Quality Manager (WQ), SCADA / IT Security Manager (TL)
fields.subject: URGENT: Orchard Standpipe — Site Verification Protocol Initiated per ERP Section 5.5
fields.body:
Per ERP Section 5.5, the site verification protocol for Orchard Standpipe has been initiated following the confirmed gate contact trips (ZS-612) at 02:15 and 04:30, and the presence of a subject on video (CAM-13) at 03:42.

Field crew (Distribution Crew 1) has been dispatched to the site with full PPE and body camera. The gate and ladder cage are to be secured with Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) upon arrival. No entry into the facility is permitted until Millbrook Police have confirmed the scene is safe and cleared for access.

Millbrook Police Dispatch has been notified and is en route. Contact: (555) 038-7100. All personnel must await law enforcement confirmation before any entry.

Preserve all video from MBW-NVR-01 (30-day overwrite) and ensure RTU-02 event logs are not altered. Do not touch any hardware, seals, or access points at the site.

This is a Level 2 condition under ERP Section 8.2. Immediate action required.
fields.signatureBlock:
Alexa Turner
Security & Emergency Manager
City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject triggers the physical security response chain. Watch for whether the Security role activates the site verification, isolates the standpipe from Zone 2, and ensures no one enters until police arrive.
